mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) potentiates tizanidine's hypotensive and CNS depressant effects, increasing risk of syncope and dizziness.
action: Monitor blood pressure and electrolytes regularly; consider alternative diuretic or adjust tizanidine dose; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions and signs of electrolyte imbalance.
